To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the residual-mass effects of domain-wall fermion simulations with a finite extent of 1/8 of the lattice spacing in the fifth direction are significantly reduced by the use of a number of low-mode projections.

(a) the residual-mass effects of the Wilson-Dirac matrix can be substantially reduced when low-lying eigenstates are projected out; (b) the projection method is applicable to both the standard Wilson and the renormalization group-improved gauge action;
the projection method substantially reduces the residual mass and the fluctuations in the residual mass for the standard Wilson and the renormalizationgroupimproved gauge action.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the reduction of residual-mass effects in domain-wall fermion simulations.
the reduction of chiral symmetry-breaking errors in lattice calculations with domain-wall fermion fields.
the development of a new method for the simulation of domain-wall fermion actions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the projection method is a very efficient tool to reduce the residual mass for domain-wall fermion actions.
the projection method is an excellent way to reduce residual-mass effects in domain-wall fermion simulations.
the projection method is very useful to reduce residual-mass effects and to obtain more precise results for the chiral condensate and for other quantities.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the projection method is a very efficient and reliable tool to reduce the residual chiral-symmetry-breaking effects for domain-wall simulations.
the projection method works well for the renormalization group-improved action, whereas it is less successful for the Wilson action.
the projection method reduces the chiral symmetry breaking of the transfer matrix for domain-wall fermion simulations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the residual-mass effects can be reduced to a level where they are no longer a problem.
the projection method can be used to reduce the residual chiral breaking for a given number of flavors and lattice size.
the projection method can be used to reduce the residual mass for domain-wall fermion simulations with the Wilson gauge action.
